svg.title: Four primary seed-42 checkpoint sweeps and the E4B JO seed-43 replicate
svg.text: Checkpoint sweeps: four primary runs and one seed-43 replicate
Upper panels: solid = test F1; dashed = validation F1; horizontal black = production. Lower panels: validation loss.
Vertical lines: dashed black = validation-F1 pick; gray = validation-loss pick. Stars: test oracle (descriptive).
